name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Lie face down on a bench set to about 45 degrees
Let the dumbbells hang with your palms facing your feet
Row with your elbows flared wide, about 65 degrees out from your torso
Drive your elbows up until they are level with your back
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly
